reports.title: ‘Enough Evidence On Trump Alone’: Raskin Hints at Major Epstein Investigation After Dems Victory
reports.description:
House Judiciary Committee Ranking Member Jamie Raskin delivers a blistering assessment of the Trump administration following the Democrats’ midterm victory, raising serious questions about the Justice Department’s handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files and Donald Trump’s relationship with Epstein.

Raskin says there was enough evidence involving Trump alone to justify further investigation, accusing the DOJ of burying the Epstein files and dismissing evidence of potential co-conspirators. He also takes aim at what he calls politically motivated prosecutions targeting Trump’s critics, while recounting the controversial arrest of his constituent.

reports.title: ‘If Any Senator Votes Yes…’: Epstein Survivors Forcefully Oppose Todd Blanche’s AG Confirmation
reports.description:
Senators Dick Durbin, Chuck Schumer, and Peter Welch join forces with Jeffrey Epstein survivors at a powerful press conference to firmly oppose the nomination of Todd Blanche for Attorney General. The survivors and lawmakers call out the mishandling of the Epstein files, the exposure of victim data, and systemic failures to protect the vulnerable. They urge the U.S. Senate to vote "No" and demand true transparency, accountability, and character from the nation's highest law enforcement office.

reports.title: US News LIVE: Dems Direct Threat to Cover-Up After Epstein Victims Hearing | Pam Bondi | Trump | DOJ
reports.description:
House Oversight Democrats in West Palm Beach, Florida, centered on the release of the Epstein files, the pursuit of justice for survivors, and demands for government accountability. Ranking Member Robert Garcia and other committee members emphasized that the crimes committed by Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell could have been prevented had authorities and prosecutors listened to survivors' and law enforcement's recommendations earlier. 

The committee is demanding that former Attorney General Pam Bondi testify publicly under oath regarding the handling and release of the Epstein files, criticizing her attempts to provide testimony behind closed doors
